item.title: FCC ALJ Denies Anuvu in C-Band Reimbursement Fight
item.description: Anuvu isn't entitled to $960,694 more for its C-band relocation expenses, FCC Administrative Law Judge Jane Halprin said Friday in an initial decision (docket 21-333.) Anuvu challenged an FCC Wireless Bureau decision rejecting some of its reimbursement claims (see [Ref:2506180021])...

item.title: Dominion Energy Supports Approval of FCC's 900 MHz Order
item.description: Dominion Energy supported a proposed FCC order launching a voluntary, negotiation-based process to transition 10 MHz in the 900 MHz band to broadband on a county-by-county basis, said a filing Thursday in docket 24-99. Commissioners vote Feb. 18 (see [Ref:2601280058])...
